title: Maui.Tizen source disposition manifest
description: Machine-readable record of what happens to every Tizen-relevant file in dotnet/maui during the extraction. This schema is the CONTRACT only; the manifest data itself is generated by the inventory tooling. Every Tizen-relevant path in both baselines must appear exactly once, so that 'we forgot about it' is not a possible outcome.

generatedFrom.description: Which baselines this manifest was generated against. Must agree with eng/baselines.json, otherwise the manifest describes a tree that no longer exists.

commitSha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA. Abbreviated SHAs and branch names are rejected on purpose: origin/net11.0 moved during the initial import, which is exactly the failure mode this guards against.

path.description: Repository-relative path AS IT EXISTS IN dotnet/maui, not in this repository.

sourceRef.description: Which baseline this file was observed in. Files present only at 9.0.120 (notably all of src/Compatibility, which was deleted upstream on net11.0) must say so.

area.description: Upstream area, e.g. Core, Controls, Essentials, BlazorWebView, Maps, Graphics, Compatibility, Build.Tasks.

kind.description: What sort of file this is, which determines how it can be migrated at all.

oneOf.description: Path is Tizen-only (a Tizen/ directory or a .Tizen.cs suffix). Can be moved wholesale.
A shared file containing #if TIZEN / #elif TIZEN branches. CANNOT be moved wholesale - only the Tizen branch is ours, and the rest belongs to the neutral MAUI assembly.
A project, props, or targets file.
Non-code asset: manifests, images, resource XML, cross-build scripts.

disposition.description: The decision for this file. Every Tizen-relevant path must carry one.

oneOf.description: Carried over at a different path or with a different name. Requires targetPath.
Reimplemented here rather than copied - typically extracting the #if TIZEN branch of a shared file, or reworking a partial type that cannot span an assembly boundary. Requires targetPath.
Stays in dotnet/maui and is consumed from the published neutral assembly. Nothing is copied.
Deliberately dropped. Requires notes explaining why, so that 'excluded' is never indistinguishable from 'overlooked'.

The file exists only at behaviorBaseline (9.0.120) and its disposition depends on a question this manifest cannot answer by itself: whether any net11 Tizen handler depends on implementation that exists only here. Used instead of a default 'exclude' so that a drop is a reviewed conclusion, not an artifact of the generator's absence-detection. Requires notes describing what to check.

targetPath.description: Path in this repository. Required for move, rename, and rebuild.

targetNamespace.description: Namespace in this repository. Existing Microsoft.Maui.* namespaces are preserved where feasible; NEW implementation-only types use Microsoft.Maui.Platforms.Tizen.* to avoid colliding with the neutral MAUI assemblies. See docs/architecture.md.

collisionRisk.description: Whether the type(s) in this file can collide with a type of the same full name in a neutral MAUI assembly that a Tizen app also loads.

provenance.description: Upstream origin, for attribution and for tracing a file back through its renames.

introducedIn.description: Upstream commit SHA that introduced the file.

historicalPaths.description: Earlier paths, e.g. Xamarin.Forms.Platform.Tizen/**. The backend predates the MAUI rename by years, so current paths alone do not identify a file's history.

notes.description: Required for 'exclude'. Free text explaining a non-obvious decision.

disposition.description: A file with #if TIZEN branches can never be a straight move: the non-Tizen branches belong to the neutral MAUI assembly, so copying the whole file would fork code we do not own.
